content.question: You need to build a classifier for a new task, but you have only a small labeled dataset and limited computing power. Which approach best fits the idea of transfer learning?
options: Train a brand-new model from scratch on the small dataset until it memorizes it.
Take a pre-trained model and fine-tune it on the small dataset.
Collect a vast amount of additional labeled data before starting.
Skip training and let the model generate its own labels.
content.answer: Take a pre-trained model and fine-tune it on the small dataset.
